purpose.zh: 练背部和臀部，让身体后面更有力
purpose.en: Build your back and glutes for a stronger back side.

text.zh: 手臂、胸口和双腿一起抬离垫子
text.en: Lift your arms, chest and legs off the mat together

text.zh: 肚子贴着垫子，眼睛看垫子。
text.en: Keep your belly on the mat and your eyes down.

text.zh: 顶端停一下，再慢慢放下。
text.en: Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Lifting your head to look forward.
Lifting too high and squeezing the lower back.

cautions.zh: 腰不舒服时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If your lower back feels uncomfortable, reduce the range, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 英文名去掉 Prone，改 Superman
起止口令按 0.7/0.6 s 缩为「抬起 / 放下」；常见错误改口语
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
